poem.author: 贺知章
englishLines: I left home young and return in old age,
My hometown speech unchanged, though my hair has thinned.
The children meet me but do not know me,
Smiling, they ask where this guest has come from.

appreciation.zh: 诗人小时候离开家乡，年老才回来。口音还是从前的口音，村里的孩子却把他当成远方客人；笑问之间，有亲切，也有时光留下的感慨。
appreciation.en: The poet left as a child and returns as an old man. His accent remains, but village children see a stranger. Their smiling question holds both welcome and the gentle surprise of passing time.

pages.zhText:
少小离家老大回，
乡音无改鬓毛衰。
儿童相见不相识，
笑问客从何处来。
pages.enText:
I left home young and return in old age,
My hometown speech unchanged, though my hair has thinned.
The children meet me but do not know me,
Smiling, they ask where this guest has come from.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Warm Tang village homecoming in spring, kind elderly poet with silver-streaked topknot and walking staff arrives on familiar stone path beside stream, three cheerful village children greet him curiously, old willow and simple homes, no text.

pages.zhText:
少小离家老大回，
小时候走出家门的少年，经过很多年，终于沿着旧路回来了。
pages.enText:
I left home young and return in old age.
The boy who once left finally comes back along the old road many years later.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Poetic time-layered scene on same village road: small translucent memory of a young boy departing blends into the same elderly poet returning, old willow and bridge unchanged, clear gentle transition, no ghost or text.

pages.zhText:
乡音无改鬓毛衰。
他的头发已经花白，说起话来却还是熟悉的家乡声音。
pages.enText:
My hometown speech is unchanged, though my hair has thinned.
His hair is silver, but his voice still carries the familiar local sound.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Friendly close view of same elderly poet chatting with a welcoming village adult near gate, silver hair visible, warm expressive gesture suggests familiar speech, no written speech bubbles, no text.

pages.zhText:
儿童相见不相识，
村里的孩子围过来看看，却没有一个人认识这位老爷爷。
pages.enText:
The children meet me but do not know me.
Village children gather, but none recognizes the elderly traveler.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Same three children approach respectfully on village path, curious friendly faces and slight distance, elderly poet smiles and leans gently on staff, no fear or mockery, no text.

pages.zhText:
笑问客从何处来。
孩子们笑着问：老爷爷，您是从哪里来的客人呀？
pages.enText:
Smiling, they ask where this guest has come from.
The children grin and wonder where their visitor came from.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Joyful conversational circle, one child gestures toward distant road while others smile, same elderly poet laughs warmly at being called a guest in his own village, no speech bubbles or text.

pages.zhText: 旧路还在，乡音也还在；只是当年的孩子成了老人，眼前又长出了一群新孩子。
pages.enText: The old road and hometown speech remain. Yesterday's child is now old, and a new group of children stands before him.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Wide same village showing continuity: old willow, bridge and stream surround elderly poet and children, subtle youthful memory reflected in water, warm everyday life, no text.

pages.zhText: 孩子的笑问让人觉得有趣，也让人轻轻想起时间走了多远。家乡既熟悉，又有了新的模样。
pages.enText: The children's question is funny and also shows how far time has traveled. Home feels familiar and new at once.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Tender sunset scene, children lead same elderly poet toward village homes, he looks around with moist but happy eyes, familiar landscape and new young faces, no intense sadness, no text.

pages.zhText:
少小离家老大回，
乡音无改鬓毛衰。
儿童相见不相识，
笑问客从何处来。
再轻轻读一遍吧。
pages.enText:
I left home young and return in old age,
My hometown speech unchanged, though my hair has thinned.
The children meet me but do not know me,
Smiling, they ask where this guest has come from.
Now read it softly once more.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Closing village homecoming, same elderly poet walks with three children across familiar stone bridge toward warm homes, willow reflected in stream, joyful welcome, no text.
